//: Example of ~/.g2cc/config.json (first run writes real defaults + a random authToken; missing keys fall back to defaults — you only need the overrides). NEVER commit a real config.json.

stt.//micSource: 'earbud' (default — Pixel Buds 2a over SCO/HFP, announced earbud-bt) | 'dji' (the retired-but-intact collar-mic path — the one-flip undo; 2026-08-04).

scout.//: Scout — the mixed-mode assistant window (docs/SCOUT.md). cwd = the session workspace (must live under /home/user/); model/effort seed the session (Options cycles them live).
quickPrompts: Show me pictures of the first result
Show me the next few results
Summarize what you found so far

notifications.//: Android package → priority (call|timer|sms|email|info). Unlisted packages = 'info'. NOTE: the map REPLACES the defaults wholesale when present (no per-package merge) — copy the defaults you want to keep.

de.//: DE shell (overhaul.md). rootNav 'menu' = the proven category launcher (default); 'ribbon' = the MRU recents ribbon (flip + restart to try on glass). recentsDepth = MRU windows shown after the fixed Main slot, before the 'frequent'+'All>' slots (Adam's spec: active + 3 = 4; keep small so the top strip never overflows). fullBleed (Phase 3 §3.3 staging, ribbon-only): true = borderless full-width windows with the action menu in a 3-cell top-bar scroller (the 96px left column reclaimed); false = the proven in-window chrome. Flip on glass to test.
de.//readerScrollRows: row cap for Reader's firmware-scroll pages (sparse content like poetry; the ~660 B byte budget binds first for prose). Default 30.

tts.//: Earbud speech lane (docs/EARBUD_SPEC.md). engine: only 'kokoro' (ARIA's proven ONNX stack, CPU-only — zero VRAM). voice: any id from voices-v1.0.bin (af_heart = Adam's pick, same as ARIA). modelDir points at ARIA's model files by default — one copy on disk.

audioOut.//: Earbud output policy. speakMode: 'auto' = TTS only when the Earbud window is NOT the visible focus (text is on glass otherwise); 'always' = both; 'never' = kill-switch. duckDb = music drop under speech. allowSpeaker MUST stay false at work — no BT route means NO sound, ever. notify per priority: speak | chime | chime+name (SMS privacy: sender only) | silent.

music.//: Earbud music lane. format 'opus' = 96k MONO loudnorm transcode, cached (cellular-kind; the one-earbud mono rule enforced at the source); 'raw' = range-served originals.

companion.//: The dedicated earbud CC session. dir holds its CLAUDE.md persona. confirmThreshold (Adam 2026-08-04): dictations at heuristic confidence ≥ this auto-send (trust-the-transcript); below it, VOICE confirmation ('say send or cancel' — waits forever, never auto-confirms). 0 = always trust, 1 = always confirm.
